actions.create_object.description: Creates a record in the selected Coupa module (Purchase Orders, Suppliers, or Contracts).
actions.create_object.props.body.descrip: JSON payload sent to Coupa, using Coupa field names in kebab-case (e.g. `po-number`, `supplier-id`). See the examples above for each module.
actions.create_object.props.bodyHelp.des:
**How to build the request body** — Coupa uses field names in **kebab-case**. Reference an existing record (like a supplier) by its numeric ID. Examples per module:

**Purchase Orders**
```json
{ "po-number": "PO-1001", "supplier": { "id": 123 }, "order-lines": [{ "description": "Laptop", "quantity": 2, "price": 1500 }] }
```

**Suppliers**
```json
{ "name": "Acme Corp", "display-name": "Acme", "status": "active" }
```

**Contracts**
```json
{ "name": "Acme MSA 2025", "supplier": { "id": 123 }, "start-date": "2025-01-01", "end-date": "2025-12-31" }
```
actions.create_object.props.customResour: API resource segment when Module is **Custom resource**, e.g. `invoices` or `approvals`.
actions.create_object.props.module.descr: Coupa module to work with: Purchase Orders, Suppliers, or Contracts. Pick "Custom resource" to target any other endpoint.
actions.custom_action.description: Make a custom API call to any Coupa endpoint (Purchase Orders, Suppliers, Contracts, or other resources).
actions.custom_action.props.failsafe.des: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_action.props.followRedire: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_action.props.headers.desc: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_action.props.response_is_: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_action.props.timeout.desc: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

auth.description: Connect using an OAuth 2.0 OpenID Connect client with the **Client Credentials** grant. In Coupa, go to **Setup → Integrations → OAuth2/OpenID Connect Clients**, create a client, and copy the Client ID and Client Secret. Scopes use the form `core.accounting.read` — list yours at `https://{your-instance}/oauth2/scopes`.
auth.props.scope.description: Space-separated scopes granted to your OIDC client, e.g. `core.purchase_order.read core.purchase_order.write`.
